question_text: A group of farmers in Nueva Ecija are demanding that the government distribute to them the vast agricultural lands owned by a large corporation, citing the constitutional mandate on agrarian reform. Under Article XIII of the 1987 Constitution, which of the following statements is most accurate regarding the state's duty?

options.text: The state must immediately expropriate all private agricultural lands without compensation to promote social justice.
The state shall promote agrarian reform by distributing lands to farmers, subject to just compensation and other legal requirements.
The state has no obligation to distribute lands because the Constitution only protects the rights of workers, not farmers.
The state may distribute lands only if the farmers form a cooperative and pay the full market value.
